title: 第9章 陈天龙兰志杰第10章 我的目标可是森林
content_zh:
毕竟是大风大雨过来的，何诗韵很快就反应过来，严肃道：“跟你聊正经的，别闹。”
张扬笑道：“你随便找几个男人问问，你跟严冰，他们会选哪一个？”
“我这辈子不会再爱上男人，如果你有这方面想法，可以打消念头。”何诗韵语气十分坚定，“严冰你可以考虑，她从来没谈过恋爱，是一个很专一的女人。”
“你怎么知道她没谈过恋爱？”
“她亲口说的，不会骗我。”
对于这个比亲姐妹还要亲近的保镖，何诗韵不会怀疑她的话。
“没谈过恋爱，那她的第一次给了谁？”
何诗韵眉头一皱：“你这话是什么意思？”
张扬嘴角微微上扬：“我修炼的武功很特殊，能通过阴气浓重程度看出一个女人是否完璧之身，还能看出一个女人多久没有性生活，比如你，已经一年以上没碰过男人了，身上阴气很重。”
何诗韵惊得半晌说不出话来，脸色也有些红。
很快，她又恢复过来，对方医术那么厉害，能看出一个女人是不是完璧之身，也有可能。
“就因为这个，你不喜欢严冰？”
张扬摇头：“我没那种情结，只是单纯不喜欢。”
强扭的瓜不甜，何诗韵也很无奈：“我看得出来，严冰对你有好感，如果你没这层意思，希望你跟她之间保持距离，不要伤害她。”
“你放心，我不会伤害她，怎么说她也是我的师傅。”
何诗韵离开之后，张扬嘴角露出一抹浅笑。
相比严冰，拥有寒气之体的何诗韵，价值更高。
一旦他沾上严冰，意味着以后跟何诗韵绝缘。
从得到《龙凤培元功》那一天开始，张扬心里就很清楚，他走的是一条不正派的路。
能守住底线，不强迫女人，让她们心甘情愿帮自己，已经很不错了。

……
江南城，最豪华的别墅区。
偌大的庭院中，兰志杰盘坐到地上，吐纳着晨曦之力。
“少爷，打探清楚了。”
一名手下过来，递上一份调查结果。
兰志杰接过，看了一眼，脸色十分难看。
出身贫寒、实习医生、没有任何背景，老子竟然被这样一个家伙吓跑。
这下，真是丢人丢人姥姥家了。
陈天龙怕是躲在哪个角落，嘲笑自己是个傻逼。
兰志杰一掌将纸震碎，霍地站了起来，朝门口走去。
“站住。”
一名唐装老者从室内走出，“大早上不练武功，要到哪去？”
“爹，我打坐太久，想出去散散心。”
兰志杰脸上杀气顿消，换成一副恭敬模样。
“别整天跟陈天龙搞在一起，会拉低你的身份，你要时刻记住，你是世家弟子，不是社会上那些市井流氓。”唐装老者严肃叮嘱。
“爹的话，儿子铭记在心。”
“铭记个屁，早两晚你干嘛去了？”
兰志杰低下头，诺诺不敢说话。
“想挑战，就光明正大去下战书，别当人家的枪。”
“爹，儿子明白了。”

兰志杰跑回书房，飞快地写下一封战书，前往永春堂。
他前脚刚离开，一名老年仆人走了过来：“老爷，要不要老奴跟去瞧瞧？”
唐装老者摆手：“那小子没有武术根底，不是志杰的对手，啥事都要你跟着，他怎么成长？”
“是，老爷。”
老仆人拱了拱手，退了下去。
content_en:
After all, it was a storm and heavy rain. He Shiyun quickly reacted and said seriously: "Let me talk to you seriously, don't make trouble."
Zhang Yang smiled and said: "You can ask a few men at random, you or Yan Bing, which one will they choose?"
"I will never fall in love with a man again in this life. If you have this idea, you can give it up." He Shiyun said in a very firm tone, "Yan Bing, you can consider it. She has never been in love and is a very dedicated woman."
"How do you know she has never been in love?"
"She said it herself, and she wouldn't lie to me."
Regarding this bodyguard who is closer than a biological sister, He Shiyun will not doubt her words.
"She has never been in love, so who did she give her first time to?"
He Shiyun frowned: "What do you mean?"
The corners of Zhang Yang's mouth raised slightly: "The martial arts I practice is very special. I can tell whether a woman is perfect through the intensity of her Yin Qi. I can also tell how long a woman has not had sex. For example, you haven't touched a man for more than a year, and your Yin Qi is very heavy."
He Shiyun was so shocked that she couldn't speak for a while, and her face turned a little red.
Soon, she recovered. Her medical skills were so good that it was possible to tell whether a woman was perfect or not.
"Just because of this, you don't like Yan Bing?"
Zhang Yang shook his head: "I don't have that kind of complex, I just don't like it."
The forceful melon is not sweet, and He Shiyun is also helpless: "I can see that Yan Bing has a crush on you. If you don't mean this, I hope you keep a distance from her and don't hurt her."
"Don't worry, I won't hurt her. After all, she is also my master."
After He Shiyun left, a slight smile appeared on Zhang Yang's lips.
Compared to Yan Bing, He Shiyun, who has a cold body, is more valuable.
Once he gets involved with Yan Bing, it means that he will be isolated from He Shiyun in the future.
From the day he obtained the "Dragon and Phoenix Pei Yuan Gong", Zhang Yang knew very well that he was taking an unrighteous path.
It's already good to be able to stick to the bottom line, not force women, and let them help you willingly.
…
Jiangnan City, the most luxurious villa area.
In the huge courtyard, Lan Zhijie sat cross-legged on the ground, breathing in the power of the morning light.
"Master, let's find out clearly."
A subordinate came over and handed over a copy of the investigation results.
Lan Zhijie took it and took a look, his face was very ugly.
Coming from a poor family, a medical intern, and without any background, I was actually scared away by such a guy.
Now, it’s really embarrassing for my grandma’s family.
Chen Tianlong was afraid that he would hide in some corner and laugh at himself for being a fool.
Lan Zhijie shattered the paper with one palm, stood up and walked towards the door.
"Stop."
An old man in Tang suit walked out of the room, "If you don't practice martial arts this morning, where are you going?"
"Dad, I have meditated for too long and want to go out and relax."
The murderous look on Lan Zhijie's face suddenly disappeared, replaced by a respectful look.
"Don't hang out with Chen Tianlong all day long. It will lower your status. You must always remember that you are a disciple of an aristocratic family, not one of the gangsters in the society." The old man in Tang suit warned seriously.
"My son will always remember his father's words."
"Forget it, what did you do two nights ago?"
Lan Zhijie lowered his head, but Nono didn't dare to speak.
"If you want to challenge, just declare the challenge openly and openly, don't use it as someone else's gun."
"Dad, my son understands."
Lan Zhijie ran back to the study, quickly wrote a letter of challenge, and headed to Yongchun Hall.
As soon as he left, an elderly servant came over and said, "Master, do you want me to follow you and have a look?"
The old man in Tang suit waved his hand: "That kid has no foundation in martial arts and is no match for Zhijie. He has to follow you in everything. How will he grow?"
"Yes, sir."
The old servant cupped his hands and retreated.
